title: Contact the team behind this timetable maker.
lead: Timetable Craft is a free schedule maker and course table maker that runs in your browser.
body: Workday is the source of record for UBC students. This site reads an Excel export in your browser, lists every section, and lets you choose what to draw on the weekly timetable.
bodyMore: Not affiliated with UBC. Times and rooms can change — always confirm in Workday.
p1b: Excel import and manual entry become the same course objects. The timetable does not care where a class came from.
p2b: There is no server login. The schedule stays in this browser until you reset it.
p3b: PNG export captures the timetable card only — not the editors.
privacyBody: Your Excel never leaves the device. Parsing, layout, and PNG export all run locally. Reset deletes the saved schedule from this browser.
contactBody: Suggestions, bugs, or questions — email {{email}}. This is an independent student project, not an official UBC or Workday service.
seoDescription: Contact the Timetable Craft timetable maker. Browser-only UBC course table tool. Email lyuchongkai@gmail.com. Not affiliated with UBC.
